senses.gloss: m. (a comp. of חרח = חרחר, to bore, sting, v. חֲרַר II, a. בּוּן, v. בִּינָא III, בִּינְתָא II) a hair-like creeper, creeper on palm-trees (cmp. חַרְגִּינִּין, הַרְדּוֹפַנִּין).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 5:3">Tosef. Shebi. V, 3</cite> <he>הרחבינה</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>החרח׳</he>).
<cite ref="Pesachim 39a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>בחרחלין ובח׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. 1 <he>ובחרחבנין</he>; Ms. M. 2 <he>ובחרבנין</he>), v. <cite ref="H01656"><he>חִרְחַלִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 39a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ובחַרְבִּינִין ובחרגינין וכ׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>ובחרחבינה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200) with palm-ivy, garden-ivy and wall-ivy.
